headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Stocks slip, but traders largely shake off warnings that AI industry should slow down
headlines.description: A rally in software and cybersecurity stocks propelled indexes off their worst levels of the day.

headlines.title: How to Prepare Your Home For Weather-Related Disasters
headlines.description: A recent survey found that 23% of homes face severe risk from wind, flood, or wildfire, so NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to share her best tips for preparing homes for disasters. She shares tips including keeping gutters clear, what kind of home insurance to get, how to take inventory and document damage, and more!

headlines.title: Strategic Money Moves to Maximize Your 401(K) Savings
headlines.description: Making informed decisions on your 401(K) can make the difference between an comfortable retirement and financial struggle, so financial expert Ted Jenkin stops by TODAY to give his best tips for maximizing savings. He breaks down catch-up contributions, explains the benefits of auto-escalation, what to do with your retirement account if you change jobs, and more.

headlines.title: Lutnick says promised $5,000 checks for Americans won't come from taxpayer dollars
headlines.description: In a wide-ranging interview, U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick spoke about the $5,000 checks Republicans are promising if they win the midterms, the Trump administration's trade war with Canada and rising energy costs. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports.

headlines.title: Regulators missed $21B in Mark Walter's insurance empire
headlines.description: A new federal investigation found that two insurers controlled by billionaire Mark Walter, owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers, put roughly $21 billion into businesses connected to him. NBC News' Gretchen Morgenson details the federal probe and how consumers can protect themselves.

headlines.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% as oil surges and diesel hits all-time high
headlines.description: Talks between Iran and Gulf countries about the future of the Strait of Hormuz were delayed after a key Saudi pipeline was hit.

headlines.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier involved in fatal Miami crash
headlines.description: Online retailer Amazon said Sunday it was suspending its use of cargo carrier 21 Air after one of its Amazon-branded aircraft crashed upon landing in Miami this month, killing five people.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Bessent dared the bond market to ‘bet against’ him. It did — and it appears to be winning.
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent appears to be losing a tug-of-war with the bond markets he is also trying to influence.

headlines.title: L.L.Bean embraces its old-school roots with brick-and-mortar stores, print catalogs, no AI
headlines.description: L.L.Bean is embracing its rugged roots in Freeport, Maine, shunning AI and adding more brick-and-mortar stores.

headlines.title: Strikes shut down key Saudi pipeline as Iran-backed Houthis tighten grip on crucial shipping lane
headlines.description: Houthi rebels effectively completed a rapid push to take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coastline on Friday, tightening their grip on one of the world’s most important shipping routes and delivering a dramatic boost to their backers in Iran.
